annotations.text:
Mobile puts the infobox FIRST, before the photo and the prose, and pushes market data below the reference content.

Today specs start 2,133 px down a 3,020 px page, under six eBay cards.

83% of lens records have no photograph. A generated optical schematic was prototyped here and cut: inferred from element counts it is not the real optical formula, and an invented drawing that looks authoritative is the wrong trade for a reference. The gap is stated instead, with a route to fix it.
The home page answers a question the site cannot answer today: what fits what. Mount navigation replaces the view-count ranking, which was crawler traffic.
